narrative.overview: Amsterdam Boat Cruise is a bright, clear ticket-comparison site: water-blue accents on white and warm paper, midnight-navy anchors for dark sections, and amber reserved for ratings. Components are warm and tactile: solid fills, softly rounded corners and paper-like cards with a light lift.
keyCharacteristics: Bright royal blue as the one action colour, on white and warm-paper surfaces
Outfit headings, Plus Jakarta Sans body text
Soft corners (12–16px) and light shadows; calm, honest booking cues

rules.name: The One Action Colour Rule
rules.body: Every booking action is royal blue. Canal blue, navy and amber never sit on a booking button.

rules.name: The Amber Is For Stars Rule
rules.body: Amber marks ratings only. It isn't used for warnings, badges or urgency.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Outfit for headings, Plus Jakarta Sans for everything else. No third font.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: The glow shadows exist in config but aren't used in new work. Depth comes from lift, not light.

dos: Do use royal blue (#2563eb) as a solid fill for every booking button in new work.
Do show prices as "from €X" with the date they were checked, and ratings as attributed text.
Do keep cards white on warm paper (#fafaf9) with 16px corners and a hairline border.
donts: Don't use tourist clichés as decoration: tulips, clogs, windmills, cartoon cheese.
Don't add urgency or pressure: "Limited spots", countdowns, "only X left".
Don't introduce new blue→indigo→sky gradients or glow shadows.
Don't use amber or brick orange on booking buttons.
